claude-args.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to every Claude session.

effort.description: The effort level codex uses for the standard tier. Empty keeps the agent's own setting.
The effort level codex uses for the light tier. Empty keeps the agent's own setting.

model.description: The model codex uses for the light tier. Empty keeps the agent's own setting.
The model codex uses for the standard tier. Empty keeps the agent's own setting.

effort.description: The effort level codex uses for the strongest tier. Empty keeps the agent's own setting.

model.description: The model codex uses for the strongest tier. Empty keeps the agent's own setting.

default-harness.description: The coding agent that new sessions start with.

fix-agent-remote-control.description: Start Claude fix-agent sessions with remote control on.

focus-sidebar-key.description: TUI only, not shown on the web page

leader-key.description: TUI only, not shown on the web page

restore-sessions-on-start.description: Resume every interactive session that was running when the server last stopped. Default: false.

attention.description: The sound file played when a session needs you, relative to the config directory. Empty uses the built-in sound.

done.description: The sound file played when a session finishes, relative to the config directory. Empty uses the built-in sound.

enabled.description: Play a sound when an interactive agent session finishes or needs you.

hard-limit.description: Estimated spend in dollars at which gx stops launching agents. 0 turns it off.

long-ticket-turns.description: Number of agent turns after which a ticket counts as long and you are alerted. 0 turns it off.

notification-thresholds.description: valid in config.json but read by nothing outside config/, so a web save would change nothing

soft-limit.description: Estimated spend in dollars at which gx warns you. 0 turns it off.

cooldown.description: The least time between two CPU captures.

enabled.description: Watch the server's CPU use and capture a profile when it stays high.

sustain.description: How long CPU use must stay high before the watchdog acts.

threshold-percent.description: CPU use, in percent of one core, that counts as high.

clean-below.description: Run the cleanup command when free disk space drops below this size. 0 turns it off.

cleanup-command.description: The command, with its arguments, that frees disk space.

warn-below.description: Warn when free disk space drops below this size. 0 turns it off.

evolve.description: What gx does when an epic completes: off, maintainer or contributor.

evolve.deep-read-cap.description: valid in config.json but read by nothing outside config/, so a web save would change nothing

max-agents.description: The most agents that run at the same time across all projects.

max-agents-per-epic.description: The most agents that work on one epic at the same time.

max-one-off-agents.description: The most agents running one-off tickets at the same time.

max-released-agents.description: The most agents that may wait with their slot released. 0 means none.

retry-storm-launches.description: valid in config.json but read by nothing outside config/, so a web save would change nothing

spin-cycles.description: valid in config.json but read by nothing outside config/, so a web save would change nothing

spin-window.description: valid in config.json but read by nothing outside config/, so a web save would change nothing

stalled-nudge-delay.description: How long an agent may be silent before it is nudged.

waiting-slot-grace.description: How long an agent that waits for an answer keeps its slot before the slot is freed.

image-diffs.description: TUI only, not shown on the web page

input-modal-bottom.description: TUI only, not shown on the web page

log.description: TUI only, not shown on the web page

name-aliases.description: TUI only, not shown on the web page

webhook-url.description: The Slack webhook address that receives notifications.

bot-token.description: The token of the Telegram bot that sends notifications.

chat-id.description: The Telegram chat that receives notifications.

ci-fix-attempts-per-check.description: The most ci-fix tickets gx files for one failing check. Default: 3.

ci-fix-attempts-per-pr.description: The most ci-fix tickets gx files for one pull request. Default: 10.

no-checks-grace.description: How long a pull request with no checks waits before it counts as green. Default: 2m.

enabled.description: Let gx try to recover tickets that get stuck.

notify-hold.description: How long recovery holds a notification back before sending it.

runner-wait.description: How long an agent runner waits on its guards before giving up.

log-retention.description: How long server logs are kept before they are deleted.

recently-finished.description: How many recently finished tickets stay listed. 0 hides them.

tab-env.description: Environment variable names copied into every new terminal tab.

tcp-listen.description: Let other machines reach the gx server over TCP, not only this machine.

watch-config.description: Reload the config automatically when config.json changes.

allowed-hosts.description: Host names the web page accepts requests for.

dev-dir.description: The Dev checkout path, overriding the one stamped into the binary. A leading ~ is expanded; otherwise it must be absolute.

dev-frontend.description: Turn on Dev mode: gx runs its own Vite from the Dev checkout and serves the web UI from it.

leader-key.description: The Leader key on other platforms, such as ctrl+e. Press it to see the chords. Empty turns chords off.

leader-key-mac.description: The Leader key on a Mac, such as cmd+e. Press it to see the chords. Empty turns chords off.

listen.description: The address the web page is served on.

totp.description: Ask for a one-time code when signing in to the web page.

vi-escape.description: A key sequence, such as "jk", that leaves insert mode in the web page's vi editors. Empty turns it off.

ci-fix.description: The skills a ci-fix ticket runs, in order. Empty uses the bundled gx-ci-fix.

code-review.description: valid in config.json but read by nothing outside config/, so a web save would change nothing

implement.description: valid in config.json but read by nothing outside config/, so a web save would change nothing

pr-text.description: The skill that writes the pull request title and body. Empty uses the bundled gx-pr-text.

stage-diff-context-lines.description: TUI only, not shown on the web page

suppress-extra-usage-warning.description: Hide the warning that appears when a subscription runs into extra paid usage.

commit-debounce.description: Seconds the ticket store waits after a change before it commits.

path.description: The directory that holds your tickets.

push-remote.description: A git remote the ticket store is pushed to after each commit. Empty means no push.

use-nerdfont-icons.description: TUI only, not shown on the web page

interval.description: How often the watchdog counts each agent's processes. Default: 1s.

max-tree-processes.description: The most processes one agent's tree may hold before the watchdog stops the agent.

ulimit-headroom.description: How many processes above your current count an agent may start. The cap is fixed when an agent launches, so restart the agent if legitimate forks start failing.
